allow: PowerShell($c = Get-Content CLAUDE.md -Raw; $a = Get-Content AGENTS.md -Raw; if \($c -eq $a\) { 'IDENTICAL' } else { Compare-Object \(Get-Content CLAUDE.md\) \(Get-Content AGENTS.md\) | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem src\\properties -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\(\\d{2}\)_\(\\d{2}\)_\(\\d{2}\)$' } | ForEach-Object { $p = $_.Name -split '_'; $mdir = "20$\($p[2]\)_$\($p[1]\)"; if \(-not \(Test-Path "src\\properties\\$mdir"\)\) { New-Item -ItemType Directory "src\\properties\\$mdir" | Out-Null }; git mv "src/properties/$\($_.Name\)" "src/properties/$mdir/$\($_.Name\)"; if \(-not $?\) { Write-Output "FAILED: $\($_.Name\)" } }; Write-Output '--- result ---'; Get-ChildItem src\\properties | Select-Object Name; Get-ChildItem src\\properties\\2026_06, src\\properties\\2026_07 -Directory | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count)

PowerShell($map = @{}; Get-ChildItem src\\properties -Recurse -Filter config.json | ForEach-Object { $cfg = Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $u = $cfg.propertyUrl; if \($u\) { $m = [regex]::Match\($u, '/\(?:immobile|inmueble|imovel|property\)/\(\\d+\)'\); $k = if \($m.Success\) { $m.Groups[1].Value } else { $u.Trim\(\).ToLower\(\).TrimEnd\('/'\) }; if \(-not $map[$k]\) { $map[$k] = @\(\) }; $map[$k] += $_.Directory.Name } }; $map.GetEnumerator\(\) | Where-Object { $_.Value.Count -gt 1 } | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Key\): $\($_.Value -join ', '\)" }; Write-Output "total configs: $\(\(Get-ChildItem src\\properties -Recurse -Filter config.json\).Count\)")
